title: CORE-6961 · homepage in-page CTAs jump + write #hash instead of smooth-scrolling
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6961](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6961) · **PR** #116

Premise confirmed on both sites, and the clone was worse than stated: **three of the four CTAs pointed at
a fragment that does not exist**.

## Scope: homepage only

All 104 pages in `pages-sitemap.xml` plus `/` crawled and grepped for `href="#`. Same-page hash anchors
appear on the homepage only, 4 of them, across FOUR different rendering paths (`CMSLink`, raw `next/link`,
`CtaLink` x2), all fed from CMS `link.url` via `getLinkHref`:

| Block | href | target existed? |
|---|---|---|
| `LandingHero` "View Pricing" | `#package-grid` | yes |
| `FourSteps` "Register Now" | `#home-top` | **no** |
| `RequiredInformation` "Register Now" | `#home-top` | **no** |
| `WhyUseAgent` "Get Started" | `#home-top` | **no** |

## What live does

Renders these as `<button type="button">`, not anchors, and scrolls in JS. From the Gatsby bundle
`app-eddaff2414d36fd20d96.js` module 82618: `n.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: t })`.
No `pushState`, no hash write. Across all five live CTAs `location.hash` is `""` immediately after the
click and 2.8s later, and `history.length` never changes.

## Before → after

| | live | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| scroll | animated ~1.3-1.5s | **instant** (<50ms) | **animated** |
| `location.hash` | `""` | `#home-top` / `#package-grid` | **`""`** |
| history entries | none (2→2) | +1 per click | **none (2→2)** |
| `#home-top` target | exists | **missing** | **exists** |

Distinct scroll samples over 1.5s went from 1-2 (i.e. already finished before the first 50ms sample)
to 12-30.

## The change

One delegated listener mounted once in the root layout (`SmoothHashScroll`), plus `id="home-top"` on
`<body>` — live carries the same id on its top-level wrapper at absTop 0. Patching the four call sites
would leave every future CMS-authored fragment broken.

**It must be registered in the CAPTURE phase.** The first build used a normal bubble-phase listener and
measuring it showed it changed **nothing** — hash still written, still instant. `next/link` handles the
click on the anchor via React's root-container listener, which runs before a bubble-phase listener on
`document`, so the router had already pushed and `preventDefault` was too late.

Left alone: modifier/middle clicks, `target` other than `_self`, `download`, cross-page fragments like
`/contact-us#ourOffices`, and already-`defaultPrevented` events.

## Regression checks (production build)

deep link `/#package-grid` → y=1108 ✅ · `/#home-top` → y=0 ✅ · `prefers-reduced-motion` → instant,
1 distinct sample ✅ · navigate away + Back → URL clean, history not inflated ✅ · cross-page anchor
untouched ✅

## Deliberate divergence

Live leaves `document.activeElement` as `BODY`. This focuses the destination (adding `tabindex="-1"`
only if absent), which is the a11y-correct behaviour for a skip-to-section control.

## Not changed

Live has `scroll-padding-top: auto`, the clone `163px` (`globals.css:17`), so `#package-grid` lands at
1108 vs live's 1291. That is a deliberate site-wide rule also relied on by `LegalSidenav`, and
`scrollIntoView({block:'start'})` honours it natively. Out of scope.
acceptanceCriteria: In-page CTAs scroll smoothly instead of jumping.
location.hash stays empty and no history entry is pushed, matching live.
#home-top resolves — the three dead fragments now have a target.
Deep links, reduced motion, Back/Forward and cross-page anchors all unregressed.
